data.one_liner: Allows you to deal with rational numbers in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Rational class for performing exact computations on rational numbers. Supports parsing from strings and initializing from integers or BigInts.
use_when: You need precise fractional arithmetic without floating-point inaccuracies
You are doing mathematical computations requiring rational numbers
avoid_when: You only need standard floating-point operations where minor precision loss is acceptable
strengths: Custom gcd implementation for improved performance
weaknesses: Slower than native floating-point types for basic operations
